item.title: JPMorgan, Jane Street probes show India scrutinizing Wall Street traders
item.description: Sebi has signaled internally that it is getting more proactive in examining transactions by domestic and international traders as part of an effort to protect retail investors ...
item.dc:creator: Bloomberg
item.content:encoded: By Saikat Das, Samie Modak and Ranjani Raghavan India is ramping up scrutiny of Wall Street traders with the nation’s securities regulator turning more aggressive in targeting even prominent foreign players like JPMorgan Chase & Co. in its $5 trillion stock market. That push has been on display in recent days as the Securities and Exchange Board of India accused a Mauritius-based JPMorgan unit of executing manipulative stock trades. Last year, in one of its most dramatic actions on a foreign firm, Sebi accused Jane Street of market manipulation, an allegation that the US financial giant has denied. Sebi has signaled internally that it is getting more proactive in examining transactions by domestic and international traders as part of an effort to protect retail investors, according to people familiar with the matter, who asked not to be identified discussing a private matter. Other global heavyweights including Bank of America Corp. and investment giant Capital Group have already found themselves in regulatory cross-hairs in India this year. It’s a sharp contrast with earlier decades when foreign securities firms were rarely penalized in the South Asian country. Now, Indian regulators are demanding a level of accountability more commonly associated with counterparts in the US and Europe.   The newer strictness comes at a time when global banks and traders have been chasing profits in what is one of the world’s fastest growing economies. Regulators are particularly focused on India’s options market, the world’s largest by contracts traded, where financial firms have been piling in to capitalize on lucrative arbitrage and market-making opportunities.  Firms like JPMorgan have increasingly made bets around the Indian market, but that calculus has the potential to change as tighter rules curb volumes and regulatory scrutiny intensifies. Many firms are now scrambling to upgrade their local compliance levels in India, lawyers said.  “Sebi’s message is unambiguous: scale, reputation and global standing offer no shelter from India’s market-conduct rules,” said Pradyun Chakravarty, a partner at New Delhi law firm King Stubb & Kasiva.  JPMorgan declined to comment. The Sebi order names a Mauritius unit that is separate from J.P. Morgan India Pvt., its local subsidiary. The order against the offshore entity, therefore, does not directly impact JPMorgan’s activities in India which are mostly conducted through its local unit. Jane Street declined to comment. It has deposited more than $500 million in an escrow account to comply with an order from India’s securities regulator, and is pursuing an appeal in an Indian court seeking access to additional documents.  Tuhin Kanta Pandey, who took over as Sebi’s chair last year, has put greater emphasis on using technology. As a result the regulatory body has begun to more closely track trades when there are sharp or unexplained swings in the market, the people familiar with the matter said, asking not to be named discussing information that isn’t public. The Indian regulator hasn’t singled out foreign firms. Domestic players have also been scrutinized with a local brokerage, Mansi Share and Stock Broking, being investigated alongside the JPMorgan unit. Still, international financial giants appeared to enjoy more leeway in the past.  Sebi is attempting to signal that it welcomes global players to India, but no one will be exempt from punishment if they are seen as breaching rules, the people familiar with the matter said. Sebi didn’t respond to an email seeking comment.  This January, Sebi sent Bank of America a show cause notice alleging employees shared non-public information about a 2024 block trade, Bloomberg News reported earlier this year, citing people familiar with the matter. The regulator alleged bank employees were sharing information between workers who were not directly involved in the deal. In May, the bank agreed to pay about $613,000 to settle the claims without denying or admitting to alleged violations. India’s market regulator has also sought information from Capital Group about trades by its entities in the local stock market that were flagged in a front-running case in early 2025, Bloomberg News has reported. Sebi is yet to pass an order in the matter. Capital Group didn’t respond to a request for comment.  In late August, regulators alleged that the JPMorgan unit, called Copthall Mauritius Investment Ltd., and the domestic firm Mansi Share placed outsized orders in Sensex stocks during the closing auction, accounting for more than 90% of orders in some of the securities it identified. They later cancelled large portions of those orders, influencing indicative closing prices without fully executing the trades, the regulator said. Copthall is likely to contend that the issue was technical in nature rather than manipulative, Bloomberg News has reported. Sebi said a trading ban on Copthall and Mansi Share would be lifted once the entities paid back nearly 37 million rupees ($390,000) in combined unlawful gains to the regulator.  At the same time, Sebi has itself faced scepticism in recent years, fueled by questions over the speed and consistency of its enforcement, as well as concerns about potential conflicts of interest. Its handling of the Adani-Hindenburg controversy has also been in the spotlight. Sebi has addressed such criticism by putting in place new regulations including those related to conflicts of interest among its top officials. It’s also grappled with other problems. Some high-frequency firms and market makers have been shying away from the new closing-auction system —  India’s latest way of setting official closing prices for stocks — partly due to fears they may have to prove to Sebi they aren’t involved in any manipulative activities, according to people familiar with the matter. This has reduced liquidity during the auction window, resulting in greater volatility leading to sudden drops in the benchmark index. The regulator has agreed to tweaks to the closing system to address early concerns. Part of its regulatory push is intended to protect retail investors from losses as they operate on the other side of the trades being conducted by sophisticated global entities. Indian retail traders lost about $9.6 billion trading equity futures and options in the year ended March. “Losses by such investors, by any yardstick, are huge,” said Ashwani Bhatia, a former Sebi official. “Some action is urgently needed.”  Still, analysts say the regulatory pressures are unlikely to keep global investors away in the long term.  “We are not seeing a structural decline in global sentiment towards India because of stronger regulation,” said Niren Patel, a Mumbai-based partner at Khaitan & Co. “Rather, global banks and investors increasingly view higher compliance standards as part of India’s market maturation.”

item.description: 10代の読解力、今世紀最低水準 スマホ視聴に原因＝ＯＥＣＤ調査 Reuters

item.title: 10代の読解力、今世紀最低水準 スマホ視聴に原因＝ＯＥＣＤ調査
item.description:
Leigh Thomas
[パリ ８日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Leigh Thomas

[パリ ８日 ロイター] - 経済協力開発機構（ＯＥＣＤ）が８日に発表した２０２５年の学習到達度調査（ＰＩＳＡ）の結果から、１０代の若者の読解力が今世紀で最低の水準に落ち込み、教育成果全般の低下につながっていることが明らかになった。スマートフォン画面を見る時間の急増が影響している。

調査は９１カ国・地域の１５歳、約７６万人を対象に実施。読解力、数学、科学の３分野全てで、得点が２０００年のデータ収集開始以来で最低となり、平均的な読解力は過去の調査における１４歳の生徒の水準にまで低下した。読解力の得点は２０１２年の５０１から２５年には４６６へ悪化した。

ＯＥＣＤのマティアス・コーマン事務総長は記者会見で、「読解力については、画面を見る時間が増え、読書を楽しむ時間が減ったことが、成績の悪化と軌を一にしている。また、急いで読む傾向も強まっており、生徒は文章をざっと読み、素早く間違った答えを出している」と述べた。

調査では、比較的恵まれた家庭の生徒ほど読解力の低下が大きかったことも分かった。

読解力の低下に引きずられる形で、１０代の生徒の平均的な科学と数学の能力も今世紀で最低となった。

最も高い成績を収めたのは東アジア地域で、中国の都市部、日本、韓国、シンガポール、台湾が上位を占めた。同地域以外で読解力、数学、科学の３分野全てでトップ１０入りしたのは英国とエストニアだけだった。

今回の報告書は、学校でのスマートフォン禁止の支持までには踏み込んでいない。しかし、調査対象となった８２の教育制度のうち５９では、デジタル機器による注意散漫が科学の成績低下と関連していると指摘した。また、４人に１人を超える生徒が、デジタル機器によって科学の授業でクラスメートの集中が妨げられていると回答した。

ＯＥＣＤによると、加盟国の生徒は平均して、平日に娯楽目的でデジタル機器を３．４時間使用し、さらに授業や自宅での学習目的に平日３時間を費やしている。

コーマン氏によると、デジタル機器は１日５時間を超えて使用すると成績が低下し始める。学習の向上にも活用できるものの、効果には限界があるという。

また、調査では、生徒のほぼ半数が学習のために人工知能（ＡＩ）チャットボットを日常的に利用していることも分かった。ただ、エッセーの作成や文章の要約、テーマの調査にＡＩチャットボットを使っている生徒は、科学の得点が平均で約２０点低かった。これは、学習１年分に相当する差だという。

item.title: 台湾海峡、紛争起これば世界経済に甚大な影響＝米駐台代表
item.description: [台北 ９日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[台北 ９日 ロイター] - 台湾にある米代表機関、米国在台協会（ＡＩＴ）のレイモンド・グリーン台北事務所長（大使に相当）は９日、台湾海峡で紛争が起これば、世界経済への影響は第２次世界大戦を上回るものになるとの認識を示した。その上で、近く行われる米中首脳会談は誤算を回避する好機だと述べた。

台北で開催された防衛フォーラムで講演し、台湾海峡の平和をいかに確保するかという課題ほど時宜にかなった重要な話題はないと指摘。「トランプ政権下の米国はインド太平洋地域の平和維持を最優先課題の一つに位置付けている」とした。

「近く行われる米中首脳会談は、公平性と互恵性に基づき、誤解や誤算を回避できる戦略的安定の関係をさらに前進させる好機になる」とも述べた。

グリーン氏はまた、米国が「好ましい地域の勢力均衡」を維持するため、インド太平洋地域におけるプレゼンスとパートナーシップを強化していると説明。「そして今日の議論に特に関連することとして、われわれは台湾の自衛能力強化に向けた取り組みを支援している」と語った。

同イベントで講演した台湾の蕭美琴副総統は、台湾には自らの防衛を強化し、幅広い安全保障上の課題に対応できるよう社会の備えを高める明確な責任があると述べた。

「われわれの目的は平和と、台湾の人々が自らの将来を決定する自由を守ることにある」とし、「備えを強化することで、その目的を着実かつ力強く追求する基盤ができる」と語った。

中国国務院台湾事務弁公室の陳斌華報道官は９日の定例記者会見で「祖国統一は止めることのできない歴史の趨勢だ」と述べた。

item.title: カナダ首相、厳しい局面続くと国民に警告－対米貿易戦争さらに激化
item.description: （ブルームバーグ）：
item.dc:creator: Bloomberg
item.content:encoded:
（ブルームバーグ）： カナダのカーニー首相は8日、米国との貿易戦争をエスカレートさせるべきだとは考えていないとする一方、米国が最近発動した関税には対抗措置が必要だったと主張した。国民には、今後の厳しい局面に備えるよう呼び掛けた。

カーニー氏は動画で、「これは簡単なことではないし、そうでないふりをするつもりもない」と述べた。「しかし、カナダ国民はこれまでも困難な時期を乗り越えてきた。その支えとなったのは、決して一つの対策だけではなかった」とした。

カーニー氏の動画投稿から数時間後、米政権は貿易摩擦をめぐり新たな一連の措置を発表した。トランプ米大統領は、「カナダが米国の農家と企業に対し、完全かつ公正で対等な扱いを回復しない限り」、米政府の調達先からカナダ製品を排除すると表明した。

さらに米政権は、多くの酒類や乳清（ホエイ）、オートバイなどのカナダ製品について、輸入を禁止する方針を発表した。米政府当局者によると、輸入禁止の対象は数十億ドル規模となる。

一連の措置は、長年の同盟国である両国の関係がなお緊迫していることを浮き彫りにした。両国間の財・サービスの貿易額は昨年、約9000億ドルだった。

カナダの対米貿易担当相を務めるドミニク・ルブラン氏は、政府が米国による最新の措置を精査しており、自身もグリア米通商代表部（USTR）代表と連絡を取っていると説明した。

ルブラン氏はX（旧ツイッター）への投稿で「米国が対話に応じる用意ができれば、われわれの政府はカナダの主権を十分に尊重した、より安全で互恵的な貿易関係の構築を目指し、誠意を持って建設的に取り組む」とした。

原題：Carney Warns of Tough Days Ahead as Trade War Spirals Again (3)（抜粋）

--取材協力：Alicia Diaz、Derek Wallbank.

item.title: 午前の日経平均は反発、円高一服で買い戻し 中東懸念はくすぶる
item.description:
Noriyuki Hirata
[東京 ９日 ロイター] - 前場の東京株式市場で日経平均は反発し、前営業日比０．３５...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
午前の日経平均は反発、円高一服で買い戻し　中東懸念はくすぶる 11:57 配信

写真は2024年12月、都内の東京証券取引所で撮影。REUTERS/Kim Kyung-Hoon

Noriyuki Hirata

[東京 ９日 ロイター] - 前場の東京株式市場で日経平均は反発し、前営業日比０．３５％（２２５円９０銭）高の６万５４９５円２３銭となった。急速な円高が警戒された為替がひとまず落ち着いた値動きとなり、過度な懸念が緩和して株価は買い戻しが目立った。一方、中東では米国とイランの間で報復の応酬が続いている。原油価格が上昇基調にあることへの懸念はくすぶっており、買い一巡後は伸び悩んだ。

・日経平均は朝安後に短時間で切り返し、一時０．８％（５２４円）高の６万５７９４円に上昇。

・中東警戒くすぶり、前場中盤以降は伸び悩み。米標準油種ＷＴＩ先物は９４ドル台で高止まり。

・イエメンの親イラン武装組織フーシが米同盟国サウジアラビアの南部４都市を攻撃。紛争拡大への懸念も。

・フジクラや古河電気工業といったデータセンター関連の上昇目立つ。米同業の株高で連想買いも。

・人工知能（ＡＩ）・半導体関連はまちまち。ソフトバンクグループはしっかりの一方、アドバンテスト、東京エレクトロンは軟調。

・前日まで円高で売られたトヨタ自動車など自動車株は自律反発。

・円長期金利が低下する中、銀行や保険など金融株さえない。

・ＴＯＰＩＸは０．３３％高の４０６３．６１ポイントで午前の取引を終了。東証プライム市場の売買代金は４兆４８２７億１７００万円。

・東証３３業種では、値上がりは非鉄金属や石油・石炭製品、鉱業など１５業種、値下がりはその他製品や証券、小売など１８業種。

・東証プライム市場の騰落数は、値上がりが６４２銘柄（４１％）、値下がりは８６７銘柄（５５％）、変わらずは４４銘柄（２％）。

＜三木証券　商品部投資情報課次長　北沢淳氏＞

「値下がり銘柄数が値上がり数を上回り、全体は強さ乏しい」

「日米で注目度高い金融政策決定会合を来週に控え様子見の側面も」

「アノマリーでは７―９月がマイナスだが、１０―１２月はプラス。調整あれば押し目買いの好機に」

「市場は中東情勢にやや楽観的か。金利への影響に引き続き注意必要」

ロイター 関連ニュース 焦点：5％に迫る米長期金利、借り入れコストや企業価値評価など5つの注目点 アングル：9月に0.5％利上げの市場観測、日銀が慎重な理由 焦点：円急伸でキャリートレード動揺、タカ派的な日銀の織り込み進む アングル：アルゼンチンのパタゴニア、データセンター建設企業が熱視線 アングル：ウクライナ首都に昼夜問わないドローン攻撃、厳しさ増す市民生活 最終更新: 9/9(水) 11:57 ロイター

item.title: Petrovietnam, KEPCO step up talks on nuclear power project
item.description: Vietnam's state energy firm Petrovietnam and South Korea's Korea Electric Power Corp have agreed to accelerate discussions on building one of Vietnam's first two nuclear power plants, as Hanoi pushes ahead with plans to revive nuclear energy.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Vietnam's state energy firm Petrovietnam and South Korea's Korea Electric Power Corp have agreed to accelerate discussions on building one of Vietnam's first two nuclear power plants, as Hanoi pushes ahead with plans to revive nuclear energy. Here are some details: Petrovietnam Chief Executive Le Manh Cuong met KEPCO President Kim Dong-cheol in Seoul on Tuesday, where the two sides discussed implementing existing cooperation agreements in the nuclear power sector and agreed to intensify exchanges on technology, investment and financing options for future projects, Petrovietnam said in a statement. The talks come as Vietnam seeks a foreign partner for the planned Ninh Thuan 2 nuclear power plant, a project that Petrovietnam has been assigned to develop. The Ministry of Industry and Trade said in July that KEPCO was a [USN:L1N4350EM TEXT:"potential partner"] following what it described as positive initial discussions with the Vietnamese company. Petrovietnam said about 97.5% of the land required for the Ninh Thuan 2 project had already been cleared, with remaining work expected to be completed soon, an important condition for advancing the project. KEPCO highlighted its experience in developing the Barakah nuclear power plant in the United Arab Emirates and expressed interest in working with Petrovietnam on an effective implementation model for the Vietnamese project, Petrovietnam said. Vietnam has already chosen Russia's state nuclear energy corporation Rosatom for the development of the other nuclear power plant, Ninh Thuan 1.

item.title: Pegula reaches third successive US Open semi-final, sets up Sabalenka rematch
item.description: Jessica Pegula reached the U.S. Open semifinals for a third successive year, coming from a set down to beat Emma Navarro 3-6 6-4 6-3 in an all-American clash on Tuesday.
item.dc:creator: Janina Rios
item.content:encoded: Jessica Pegula reached the U.S. Open semifinals for a third successive year, coming from a set down to beat Emma Navarro 3-6 6-4 6-3 in an all-American clash on Tuesday. The 32-year-old will face two-time defending champion Aryna Sabalenka in a rematch of the 2024 final after securing her fifth straight win over her compatriot, including a victory at last month's Cincinnati Open. The clash, dubbed by American media as the "Battle of the Billionaires" because of their backgrounds, began more than an hour later than scheduled after Frances Tiafoe's marathon victory over Alex Michelsen in another all-American contest. The wait did little to help either player find their rhythm, with the match instead marked by errors and few sustained bursts of momentum. The 26th seed had the edge in a scrappy opening set as both players struggled to settle. They traded early breaks and each hit five double faults, with an extra break allowing Navarro to move one set ahead. The miscues continued in the second, but Pegula found a slight improvement that allowed her to level the match, finishing a long exchange with a fine forehand winner to make it one set apiece. Pegula carried that momentum into the decider, where an extra break put her in control before she closed out the victory. "It was really tough, really physical, I wasn't serving my best, I was fighting a lot of demons out there," Pegula said on court. "I do a great job on having a short term memory, I know everytime I come out no matter what I have to tell the negative me to shut up and just play tennis and compete." The victory was also Pegula's 50th of the season, making her the first player on the women's tour to reach that mark in 2026.

item.title: 企業想定超す円高、日本株は内需関連が主役に－輸出の業績下押し警戒
item.description: （ブルームバーグ）：
item.dc:creator: Bloomberg
item.content:encoded:
（ブルームバーグ）： 円相場が上場企業の業績予想の前提となる想定レートを超えて上昇し、株式市場で投資家の関心が円高の恩恵が見込まれる内需関連株に向かい始める可能性がある。

ブルームバーグの集計によると、東証株価指数（TOPIX）構成企業のうち約220社が開示する想定為替レートの平均は1ドル＝153円90銭。円相場は日本銀行の利上げ観測などを背景に、8日に一時152円台後半まで上昇した。日本企業は為替変動による年度途中の業績下方修正を避けるため、為替レートを保守的に想定する傾向がある。

東海東京インテリジェンス・ラボの平川昇二チーフグローバルストラテジストは、目先は投資家が輸出関連株を売り、円高や金利低下の恩恵を受ける不動産や建設などの内需関連業種に資金を移す可能性があると話す。

東京株式市場で自動車が中心のTOPIX輸送用機器指数は、為替が円高基調に転じた月初から約8%下落。これに対し、建設や電気・ガスなど内需主導業種は市場全体を上回るパフォーマンスとなっている。

最近は為替の影響が比較的小さいAI・半導体関連の存在感が増しているとはいえ、日本株全体としては円安による業績押し上げ効果が依然大きな支えだ。野村証券が第1四半期の営業利益の増減要因を開示する約190社を分析したところ、為替は約8300億円の増益要因で値上げや数量増などの効果を上回った。円安メリットがなくなって利益成長が鈍化すれば、日本株に逆風となる可能性がある。

ニッセイ基礎研究所の井出真吾チーフ株式ストラテジストは「一段と円高が進めば、企業業績へのネガティブな影響が意識されやすくなる」と指摘。最近の円高傾向が一過性かどうかが今後の焦点になるとし、「当面は安心感の強い内需株が相対的に強い展開が続く」との見方を示した。

足元の企業業績は値上げの浸透やAI需要などを背景に、為替影響を除いても堅調だ。また、歴史的な円安に至ったファンダメンタルズが大きく変わったわけではなく、今後も円高が続くとは限らない。

item.title: Legacy Motor Club picks Josh Berry to drive No. 42
item.description: Josh Berry will be behind the wheel of the No. 42 Toyota for Legacy Motor Club beginning in 2027.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Josh Berry will be behind the wheel of the No. 42 Toyota for Legacy Motor Club beginning in 2027. Legacy announced the signing Tuesday just six days after saying it would part ways with current No. 42 driver John Hunter Nemechek. "Josh is a proven competitor who has earned everything through hard work and getting his hands dirty," Legacy co-owner Jimmie Johnson said in a press release. "What stands out about Josh is his ability to manage the big picture behind the wheel -- his experience, perspective and wisdom. His career has been built on that foundation, and I know he will have a meaningful impact here. We're thrilled to have him at Legacy." Berry, 35, will embark on his fourth full-time season with his third team. He spent 2024 with Stewart-Haas Racing driving the No. 4 Ford before signing with Wood Brothers Racing, where he's driven the No. 21 Ford. Wood Brothers had already confirmed plans to not retain Berry following this season. Berry, whose lone NASCAR win came at the 2025 Pennzoil 400 at Las Vegas Motor Speedway, has heated up of late. He has an active streak of six consecutive top-10 finishes, including fourth place at Iowa and third at New Hampshire. When he was a part-time driver in 2023, Berry made two starts for Legacy behind the wheel of the No. 42. He placed 34th at Michigan and 22nd in the Coke Zero Sugar 400 at Daytona that year. Lee Petty, Richard Petty and Kyle Petty have all driven the No. 42 car over the years, along with the likes of Kyle Larson and Juan Pablo Montoya. Nemechek was in his third season in the car and has yet to record a win or a playoff appearance in the NASCAR Cup Series. --Field Level Media

item.title: ホルムズ海峡通過船、8日は6隻に減少＝海運データ
item.description: [シンガポール ９日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[シンガポール ９日 ロイター] - コモディティー分析会社ケプラーが９日発表した海運データによると、８日にホルムズ海峡を通過した商品運搬船の数は６隻となり、前日の９隻から減少した。過去１０日間の平均である約１２隻も下回った。

一方、紅海側の要衝バベルマンデブ海峡を通過する船舶数は２５隻だった。１０日間平均は約２７隻だった。

一部の船舶はトランスポンダー（船舶自動識別装置）をオフにした状態で海峡を通過している可能性があり、その場合は集計に含まれない。

イエメンの親イラン武装組織フーシ派は８日、米国の同盟国サウジアラビアの南部４都市を攻撃し、多数の負傷者が出たほか、石油関連施設で火災が発生した。

一方、米当局者によると、米軍は同日、イランのイスラム革命防衛隊と関係のある複数のタンカーを攻撃。開戦から半年に及ぶ中東紛争が拡大した。

item.title: Reports: LSU fills football roster without controversial ex-pros
item.description: LSU apparently abandoned its plan to incorporate two players who were in NFL training camps this season, filling its 105-man roster on Tuesday without including tight end Dae'Quan Wright and defensive lineman Zxavian Harris, according to multiple media outlets.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: LSU apparently abandoned its plan to incorporate two players who were in NFL training camps this season, filling its 105-man roster on Tuesday without including tight end Dae'Quan Wright and defensive lineman Zxavian Harris, according to multiple media outlets. Wright and Harris were two of dozens of players who received legal intervention to receive an additional year of NCAA eligibility despite having exited college for the chance at a pro career. Lawsuits in multiple states resulted in rulings that would have permitted those players to play college ball again, despite strong objections from the Southeastern Conference and the NCAA. The SEC filed a federal lawsuit seeking to prevent LSU from rostering or using the former pros, and on Tuesday the conference scheduled a meeting for Thursday to vote on whether to expel LSU from the league. When LSU submitted its roster ahead of the season opener on Saturday against Clemson, 103 players were included. That left open the possibility of Wright and Harris being added at a later date, as long as they remained enrolled in school. However, on Tuesday, the Tigers filled the last two roster spots with cornerback Aidan Anding and defensive end Gabriel Reliford, according to multiple media reports. Wright and Harris were 42 athletes across multiple sports who were covered by the preliminary injunction granted last week in an East Baton Rouge Parish district court, a decision rooted in the NCAA's pivot to a new five-year eligibility system. Judge William Jorden's ruling temporarily prevented the SEC and the NCAA from enforcing rules that would keep the athletes from playing college sports in the new school year. Wright signed with the Philadelphia Eagles as an undrafted free agent in the offseason, then was claimed off waivers by the Cleveland Browns, who subsequently waived him in late August. Harris signed an undrafted free agent contract with the New Orleans Saints before they waived him in early August. Both Harris and Wright played for new LSU coach Lane Kiffin last season at Ole Miss. LSU won its opener 51-10 over Clemson, racking up a 644-145 edge in total yards. In the new AP Top 25 poll released on Tuesday, LSU rose from No. 11 to No. 8. --Field Level Media

item.title: ホルムズ海峡混乱は中小企業に負担大、供給網から排除の恐れ＝国連
item.description: [ジュネーブ ８日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[ジュネーブ ８日 ロイター] - 国連貿易開発会議（ＵＮＣＴＡＤ）は８日の報告で、ホルムズ海峡の混乱により中小企業が世界のサプライチェーン（供給網）から締め出され、経済の集中が進んで国際貿易の強靭性が損なわれる恐れがあるとの見解を示した。

米国とイランの戦争に端を発したエネルギー料金や貨物運賃、保険料の上昇、資金調達の制約は、大企業より中小企業に重い負担となっている。供給元、市場、資金調達源を多様化できる大企業と比べ、中小企業はより脆弱な状況に置かれている。

報告によると、中小企業は世界の企業の約９０％、雇用の７０％、世界の国内総生産（ＧＤＰ）の５０％を占めており、今回の混乱は海運以外にも広く波及するリスクをはらんでいる。

ＵＮＣＴＡＤは、今回の混乱が「中小企業排除効果」を引き起こすリスクがあると警告した。貿易量全体が最終的に改善しても、中小企業が生産縮小、投資の先送り、バリューチェーンからの完全な撤退を余儀なくされる恐れが生じるという。

最近の混乱は既に、原油価格上昇、船舶輸送量の減少、借り入れコストの上昇に表れており、電力や輸入手続き順守などの事業運営コストが大企業より相対的に高い中小企業に特に重くのしかかっていると指摘した。

item.title: China curbs humanoid IPOs after Unitree’s volatile debut, The Information reports
item.description: Chinese regulators are tightening the approval for humanoid startups planning IPOs after a volatile debut by industry leader Unitree Robotics, The Information reported on Wednesday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Chinese regulators are tightening the approval for humanoid startups planning IPOs after a volatile debut by industry leader Unitree Robotics, The Information reported on Wednesday. The China Securities Regulatory Commission has given an informal “window guidance” to some investment banks and firms that it is lifting the bar for approving humanoid startups that plan to go public, the report said, citing people with knowledge of the matter. These companies must prove they can generate recurring revenue and are on track to narrow their losses or achieve real innovation before approvals can be considered, The Information said. Chinese financial regulators did not immediately respond to a Reuters request for comment. Reuters could not verify the report. According to the Information report, the change in strategy was prompted by factors including a funding frenzy in the private market this year, a long list of companies that have filed for IPOs, and tanking share prices of companies such as Unitree that went public recently. A roughly 45% [USN:L4N44K01K TEXT:"slump"] in the shares of Unitree, China's best-known humanoid robot maker, since a more than fivefold jump in its Shanghai debut has triggered concerns about a bubble, retail investor losses and flaws in the IPO system.

item.title: Hot-hitting Pirates jump on White Sox early in win
item.description: Spencer Horwitz had two hits and drove in three runs, including an RBI single in a five-run first inning, and Bubba Chandler pitched six sharp innings as the visiting Pittsburgh Pirates routed the Chicago White Sox 9-3 on Tuesday.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: Spencer Horwitz had two hits and drove in three runs, including an RBI single in a five-run first inning, and Bubba Chandler pitched six sharp innings as the visiting Pittsburgh Pirates routed the Chicago White Sox 9-3 on Tuesday. Every starter had at least one hit for the Pirates (72-73), who won for the seventh time in nine games to remain in the hunt for the third National League wild card. Oneil Cruz and Rafael Flores Jr. paced Pittsburgh's 18-hit attack with three hits apiece. Chicago (75-69) saw its lead atop the American League Central dwindle to two games over the Cleveland Guardians. Pittsburgh reached White Sox starting pitcher Sean Burke for seven runs and eight hits in 1 1/3 innings. Burke had two walks and two strikeouts but surrendered five doubles. Burke (8-7) struggled against the Pirates from the get-go. The right-hander yielded four doubles, two singles and a walk to open the game before recording his first out with a strikeout of Jacob Gonzalez. Bryan Reynolds gave the Pirates the lead with an RBI double three batters into the game. Cruz lined a two-run double one batter later and scored on an Esmerlyn Valdez ground-rule double one batter after that. Horwitz capped the rally with an RBI single. Konnor Griffin, Brandon Lowe, Jake Mangum and Reynolds each had two hits. Flores hit a solo home run against reliever Jose Urquidy in the fifth. The early run support helped boost Chandler (7-9) to his first victory since Aug. 14. The righty scattered four runs, two hits and eight strikeouts in six innings. Chicago got on the board with Braden Montgomery's RBI single in the fifth. Kyle Teel homered for the second straight game to make it 9-2 in the sixth. The White Sox added a seventh-inning run on a Colson Montgomery groundout in the seventh. Andrew Benintendi and Teel both had two hits for Chicago. The White Sox have lost four of six. Pittsburgh matched a season-high with six doubles. --Field Level Media

item.title: 新興国企業の利益予想、過去最速で上昇－AI投資ブーム追い風
item.description: （ブルームバーグ）：
item.dc:creator: Bloomberg
item.content:encoded:
（ブルームバーグ）： 新興国企業の利益予想が過去最速のペースで上昇している。米ハイパースケーラー（大規模クラウド事業者）の設備投資から恩恵を受ける企業について、アナリストが予想を引き上げている。

ブルームバーグがまとめたデータによると、MSCI新興国市場指数を構成する企業の今後12カ月の平均利益予想は7日まで19営業日連続で上昇し、年初来の伸びは65%に達した。これまで過去最高だった2009年の記録をほぼ2倍上回る。勢いは強く、6月19日以降、予想が引き上げられなかったのはわずか1日だけだった。

投資家は、急速に拡大する世界のAIサプライチェーンに関連する銘柄へ資金を振り向けている。今年前半は、韓国のSKハイニックスとサムスン電子、台湾積体電路製造（TSMC）の3社が株高と利益予想の上方修正を主にけん引していたが、ここ数カ月で恩恵を受ける企業の裾野が広がった。

モルガン・スタンレー・インベストメント・マネジメントでソリューション・マルチアセット部門の副最高投資責任者を務めるジタニア・カンダリ氏（ニューヨーク在勤）は、「ハイパースケーラーの設備投資は、インフラ企業の売上高になる」と指摘。「ハイパースケーラーによる設備投資が続いていることを示す決算データが材料になっている」と述べた。

半導体から電力機器、データセンター用ラックまで、AI投資ブームの恩恵を受ける企業の株高が、MSCI新興国市場指数を年初来25%押し上げている。1月1日から9月8日までの上昇率としては、17年以来最大となった。

業種別では、IT株の利益予想の伸びが最も大きく、年初来214%に達した。韓国SKスクエアなど一部のAI関連銘柄を含む資本財・サービス株は72%増。素材株は32%、エネルギー株は38%それぞれ上昇したことが、ブルームバーグの集計で分かった。

新興国市場は、先進国の財政悪化や、中東紛争を背景に高インフレが長引く恐れを懸念する世界の投資家にとって、有力な投資先となりつつある。

item.title: 韓国軍、北朝鮮の軍事境界線侵犯を注視 即応態勢維持
item.description: [ソウル ９日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[ソウル ９日 ロイター] - 韓国軍は９日、南北軍事境界線の侵犯を含む北朝鮮の活動を注意深く監視し、確固たる軍事的即応態勢を維持していると表明した。

北朝鮮軍による同境界線の侵犯が８月に２０回以上確認されたとする朝鮮日報の報道を受けて声明を発表した。

同紙は複数の軍関係者の話として、韓国軍が探知した北朝鮮軍の侵犯回数が８月だけで２０２５年通年の総数を上回ったと報じた。侵犯は北朝鮮軍が境界線付近で地雷敷設やフェンス建設など要塞化作業を再開する中で起きたという。

韓国合同参謀本部は「軍は作戦手順に従って原則に基づいた措置を講じており、能力の強化を続けていく」と表明した。

報じられた侵犯の回数や場所、時期に関する詳細は明らかにしなかった。

item.title: Oil heads for $100, Asia stocks subdued as Middle East tensions escalate
item.description: Brent crude rallied towards $100 per barrel on Wednesday, keeping the mood in Asian stock markets subdued, as attacks intensified in the Middle East, stoking inflation worries ahead of the release of closely watched U.S. consumer price data.
item.dc:creator: Kevin Buckland
item.content:encoded: Brent crude rallied towards $100 per barrel on Wednesday, keeping the mood in Asian stock markets subdued, as attacks intensified in the [USN:L6N45005Y TEXT:"Middle East"], stoking inflation worries ahead of the release of closely watched U.S. consumer price data. The yen strengthened towards the nearly seven-month high touched against the dollar on Tuesday as traders [USN:L1N45008C TEXT:"exited"] short positions in the Japanese currency amid expectations for faster Bank of Japan interest rate hikes and a potential rush of repatriation of Japanese capital. The euro edged higher ahead of the European Central Bank's policy [USN:L6N44V0GE TEXT:"decision"] on Thursday, with markets widely expecting a hike amid inflationary pressures from the Iran war. Iranian-backed Houthis in Yemen launched strikes on several Saudi cities on Tuesday, further embroiling a U.S. ally in the conflict, while U.S. forces hit multiple Iranian oil tankers and Iran struck a U.S. base in Jordan. Oil prices jumped for a fourth straight session on Wednesday, gaining more than $1 in early trade. Brent crude futures rose $1.57 to $99.49 a barrel, the highest level since late June. U.S. West Texas Intermediate crude was at $94.63 a barrel, up $1.60. Stocks in Sydney (.AXJO) slipped around 0.3%, while Hong Kong's Hang Seng (.HSI) dropped 0.6% and mainland Chinese blue chips (.CSI300) edged up 0.2%. A rebound in chip and AI stocks helped some other regional benchmarks though, with Japan's Nikkei (.N225) up 0.6% following Tuesday's 1.7% tumble. South Korea's KOSPI (.KS11) jumped 1.6% and Taiwan's TAIEX (.TWII) rose 0.6%. Japanese cable makers surged after Verizon and Corning signed a [USN:L6N4500QH TEXT:"deal"] on high-density optical fibre. Overnight, the Philadelphia SE semiconductor index (.SOX) jumped 1.3%, despite declines on Wall Street's three main indexes. U.S. S&P 500 futures added 0.1%, after the cash index (.SPX) sank 0.6% on Tuesday. "Across several of the major macro markets, we see indecision in the price action -- tight ranges and a general holding/consolidation pattern," Chris Weston, head of research at Pepperstone, wrote in a client note. Brent crude is currently "one of the clearest real-time signals for sentiment" for the overall market, and $100 "now feels like a highly achievable level," he said. Inflation worries have weighed on global equities in recent weeks and lifted bond yields as traders price higher odds for central bank tightening. U.S. CPI data is due on Friday. Traders assign close to even odds for a quarter-point hike or a hold from the U.S. Federal Reserve on Wednesday of next week, while being all but certain of a quarter-point increase from the BOJ two days later. The yen strengthened around 0.2% to 153.66 per dollar , edging back towards its high of 152.89 from the previous session. It had surged around 4% over the last five sessions, with hawkish comments from BOJ officials ostensibly initiating a move that then snowballed as breaks of key levels triggered additional buying, market players said. The ECB is all but certain to raise euro zone rates by a quarter point on Thursday. The euro added 0.1% to $1.1629, putting it in the middle of its tight range of the past three weeks. Sterling was little changed at $1.3545, with the Bank of England due to announce its latest policy decision on Thursday of next week, with economists [USN:L6N4500E1 TEXT:"predicting"] the key rate will be on hold for the remainder of this year. The Aussie rose 0.1% to $0.7222. Bitcoin drifted higher to change hands at $78,680.60. Gold gained 0.3% to around $4,368 an ounce.

item.title: Indian rupee under pressure with Brent near $100 testing RBI defence
item.description: The Indian rupee is likely to extend losses on Wednesday, weighed down by a further rise in oil prices, which would test the central bank's ability to cushion the currency.
item.dc:creator: Nimesh Vora
item.content:encoded: The Indian rupee is likely to extend losses on Wednesday, weighed down by a further rise in oil prices, which would test the central bank's ability to cushion the currency. The rupee is expected to open in the 94.84 to 94.86 range, per traders, having settled at 94.8175 to the dollar in the previous session. The South Asian currency fell the most in nearly a month on Tuesday with the rise in oil prices countering the Reserve Bank of India's efforts to keep it anchored. The RBI has used regular and, at times, forceful intervention in recent weeks to push the rupee higher, helping drive the currency to a two-month high late last week. While the central bank was present in the market on Tuesday, traders said the intervention was not enough to prevent the rupee from weakening. The decline marked a departure from the recent market action and could signal the RBI is becoming less inclined to support the currency aggressively when the underlying pressure is driven by oil, a currency trader at a bank said. RBI may be increasingly mindful of using its FX reserves to push the rupee higher in an environment that is becoming more negative for the currency, he said. "It will not be a surprise" if the rupee falls to 95, he added. OIL HEADWINDS MOUNT Oil prices rose for the fourth straight session after Iran launched fresh attacks on U.S. military assets in the Gulf. Worries over the war between Washington and Tehran spilling out across the region lifted Brent to $99.66 per barrel, the highest since late July. Higher crude prices could strengthen the case for a Federal Reserve rate hike next week, adding to support for the dollar and leaving the rupee facing pressure from both higher import demand and a rise in U.S. Treasury yields.

item.title: Indian shares decline on crude spike; Coforge tumbles after chairman's exit
item.description: Indian shares fell on Wednesday as a fresh escalation in the Middle East conflict had Brent crude hurtling toward $100 per barrel, a pain point for the world's third-largest crude oil importer.
item.dc:creator: Bharath Rajeswaran, Vivek M
item.content:encoded: Indian shares fell on Wednesday as a fresh escalation in the Middle East conflict had Brent crude hurtling toward $100 per barrel, a pain point for the world's third-largest crude oil importer. The Nifty 50 (.NSEI) fell 0.67% to 23,474.4 and the BSE Sensex (.BSESN) lost 0.83% to 74,954.33 as of 10:01 a.m. IST. Twelve of the 16 major sectors logged losses. IT index (.NIFTYIT) slid 3%, with constituent Coforge (COFO.NS) [USN:L4N45107S TEXT:"tumbling"] 6% after Chairman Om Prakash Bhatt resigned following concerns raised by an internal audit over the company's board evaluation process. The broader small-caps (.NIFSMCP100) and mid-caps (.NIFMDCP100) lost 0.6% and 0.7%, respectively. The Middle East [USN:L6N45005Y TEXT:"war intensified"] on Tuesday with Iranian-backed Houthis in Yemen launching strikes on several Saudi cities, further embroiling a U.S. ally in the conflict, while U.S. forces hit multiple Iranian oil tankers and Iran struck a U.S. base in Jordan. Brent crude futures jumped 1.5% to $99.5 per barrel. Higher oil prices threaten to widen the trade deficit, fuel inflation, and weigh on growth in India. "With crude inching towards $100 a barrel, the whole sentiment view changes for the worse for domestic equities after what has been a stable earnings season," said Aman Chowhan, head of equities of Alternates at Abakkus AMC, adding, "Higher crude also brings a potential near-term U.S. rate hike to the table, which is negative for emerging market equities." "Flows are also getting diverted from secondary markets with IPOs, QIPs hitting the Street every other day, which is compounding the pressure," Chowhan said. Bucking the trend, Graphite India (GRPH.NS) climbed over 13% to a near eight-year high after global graphite electrode leader GrafTech International announced a 30% minimum price hike. Adani Enterprises (ADEL.NS) gained 3.6% after it agreed to sell up to a 5.54% stake in its airport unit, raising about $1 billion from a group of investors comprising Temasek, BlackRock (BLK.N) , Premji Invest and Alpha Wave to fund the business.

item.title: Rays sock 4 home runs, roll to blowout win over Braves
item.description: Freddy Peralta pitched six strong innings and the visiting Tampa Bay Rays hit four home runs en route to a 7-1 victory over the Atlanta Braves on Tuesday in the opener of a three-game series featuring division leaders.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: Freddy Peralta pitched six strong innings and the visiting Tampa Bay Rays hit four home runs en route to a 7-1 victory over the Atlanta Braves on Tuesday in the opener of a three-game series featuring division leaders. Tampa Bay (86-58) won for the third time in four games to maintain a four-game edge over the New York Yankees (82-62) in the American League East. Atlanta (85-60) took its third loss in four games but remains four games ahead of the Philadelphia Phillies (81-64). Peralta (8-11) allowed one run on five hits and one walk while striking out two. He has won three consecutive starts, and he improved his career record against Atlanta to 7-2. Tampa Bay's Kevin Kelly pitched a perfect seventh inning, Cole Sulser followed with a perfect eighth and Bryan Baker worked a 1-2-3 ninth inning. Braves starter AJ Smith-Shawver (0-2) pitched 3 1/3 innings and gave up four runs on five hits and two walks. He fanned three. Junior Caminero clobbered a fastball from Smith-Shawver for a 455-foot solo homer in the first inning, giving him the American League home run lead at 39. He needs one homer to become the franchise's first player with multiple 40-homer seasons. The Braves tied the game 1-1 in the bottom of the first on consecutive singles by Ronald Acuna Jr., Matt Olson and Drake Baldwin. Atlanta left the bases loaded when Austin Riley struck out to end the inning. The Rays took the lead for good with a three-run outburst in the third inning. Liam Hicks hit a two-run homer to center field, his 18th. Hicks has hit safely in all nine career games at Truist Park. Later in the frame, Victor Mesa Jr., celebrating his 25th birthday, added an RBI single. Tampa Bay scrambled for a run in the sixth. Jorge Mateo singled, advanced on Brent Suter's errant pickoff attempt and scored on Yandy Diaz's infield grounder. The Rays struck for two more solo homers against reliever Elieser Hernandez. Diaz hit a 393-foot shot, his 22nd, in the eighth inning, and Richie Palacios socked a 381-foot line drive, his ninth long ball, in the ninth. --Field Level Media

item.title: US judge dismisses suit by British anti-disinformation activist against deporting him
item.description: A federal judge in New York dismissed a lawsuit by British anti-disinformation campaigner Imran Ahmed that challenged the Trump administration's ability to detain and deport him.
item.dc:creator: Kanishka Singh, Nate Raymond
item.content:encoded: A federal judge in New York dismissed a lawsuit by British anti-disinformation campaigner Imran Ahmed that challenged the Trump administration's ability to detain and deport him. U.S. District Judge Loretta Preska in Manhattan said on Tuesday that while Ahmed "very well may have valid causes of action," she was required to conclude under a recent appellate court ruling that she lacked jurisdiction to hear his free speech and due process claims under the U.S. Constitution. Preska's ruling opens the door to Ahmed's detention, but the judge said she would leave the earlier restraining order in effect for five business days to allow Ahmed time to pursue an appeal. President Donald Trump's immigration crackdown and his administration's use of visa and green card revocations have faced legal challenges that have divided U.S. courts. Late last year, a U.S. judge [USN:L6N3XV0AO TEXT:"temporarily blocked"] the Trump administration from detaining Ahmed, after the U.S. permanent resident sued officials over an entry ban for his role in what Washington alleges is online censorship. Washington had imposed visa bans last year on Ahmed and four Europeans, accusing them of working to censor freedom of speech or unfairly target U.S. tech giants with burdensome regulation. Ahmed, the 47-year-old CEO of the U.S.-based Center for Countering Digital Hate, lives in Washington. He says his wife and child are both U.S. citizens. He did not immediately respond to a request for comment. A federal judge in July [USN:L1N43G11S TEXT:"blocked"] the Trump administration from enforcing the policy that targeted foreign nationals who study disinformation and hate speech on social media for visa denials and deportation. Legal permanent residents, known as green card holders, do not need a visa to remain in the U.S., but the Trump administration has attempted to deport some over their political views, such as participation in [USN:L4N3SN13Z TEXT:"pro-Palestinian protests"] against U.S. ally Israel's war in Gaza . Trump has cast such voices as "anti-American" and as foreign policy threats. Advocates have raised free speech and due process concerns and said the Trump administration is punishing such people for criticism of the U.S. government. The Trump administration has also [USN:L4N44O22P TEXT:"initiated probes"] against some [USN:L4N3ZE1TJ TEXT:"activists"] and [USN:L6N44913F TEXT:"rights advocates"] and sanctioned [USN:L4N44V1RF TEXT:"some international judges"].

item.title: Yankees flummox Rockies in Aaron Judge’s return
item.description: Ryan McMahon lined a tiebreaking double with one out in the fifth inning against his former team, Cam Schlittler pitched seven strong innings, and the host New York Yankees made Aaron Judge's return from the injured list a successful one with a 5-3 victory over the Colorado Rockies on Tuesday night.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: Ryan McMahon lined a tiebreaking double with one out in the fifth inning against his former team, Cam Schlittler pitched seven strong innings, and the host New York Yankees made Aaron Judge's return from the injured list a successful one with a 5-3 victory over the Colorado Rockies on Tuesday night. The Yankees (82-62) won for the 14th time in 21 games and matched a season-high by moving 20 games over .500 in Judge's first game since May 31. After missing 84 games with a fractured right rib, Judge went hitless in three at-bats, struck out twice and did not make any plays while handling right field for six innings. Following a single by rookie George Lombard Jr., McMahon lined a pitch from Colorado rookie starter Gabriel Hughes (0-7) off the bottom of the right field fence to easily score New York's rookie shortstop. Luis Garcia Jr. hit a run-scoring single in the first that plated Cody Bellinger when left fielder Jake McCarthy was charged with two errors. McCarthy kicked the ball and made an errant throw to the plate that eluded catcher Hunter Goodman. Schlittler (13-6) allowed one run on three hits in seven innings to win his third decision in four starts (all team wins). The right-hander struck out 10 without a walk and allowed one run or fewer for the sixth straight start and 20th time overall. McMahon's clutch hit and Schlittler's latest strong showing helped the Yankees clinch their 34th straight winning season. New York has not had a losing season since finishing 76-86 in 1992. Heliot Ramos replaced Judge in right field after the sixth and contributed a three-run homer in the eighth to pad the lead. Ramos' homer proved crucial for the Yankees when Tim Hill allowed a two-run homer to Hunter Goodman in the ninth. After Goodman hit his 37th homer, David Bednar fanned Mickey Moniak for his 32nd save. Adael Amador hit a tying homer to open the third as the Rockies (55-89) dropped their fifth straight road game and fell to 25-48 away from home. In his 12th career appearance, Hughes allowed two runs (one earned) on four hits in five innings. The right-hander and former first-round pick struck out six and walked none. Judge was activated after going through a round of live batting practice. He struck out swinging in the first, flew out in front of the warning track in center field in the fourth and took a called third strike on a full count in the sixth against rookie reliever Mark Manfredi. --Field Level Media

item.title: Tiafoe dreaming bigger in latest US Open semi-final berth
item.description: Frances Tiafoe has higher hopes for himself in his latest U.S. Open run, after a nerve-testing five-set comeback on Tuesday to reach the semi-final for a third time and underscore his mettle at the year's final major.
item.dc:creator: Amy Tennery
item.content:encoded: Frances Tiafoe has higher hopes for himself in his latest U.S. Open run, after a nerve-testing five-set comeback on Tuesday to reach the semi-final for a third time and underscore his mettle at the year's final major. The 11th seed has provided treasured memories for the home fans in New York, from his dragon-slaying defeat of Rafa Nadal en route to the 2022 semi-final, to his [USN:L4N3KH1B6 TEXT:"blockbuster win"] over compatriot Ben Shelton two years ago. But the Cincinnati runner-up this year is ready to write a new chapter this time around, after a roller-coaster [USN:L6N450174 TEXT:"comeback performance"] against Alex Michelsen over five sets. "I'm just a different person in general. Those two runs (to the semi-finals) were great, something I will cherish forever, but I'm not that person who I was when I made one in 2022 and when I made one in '24. I'm not that person. I'm excited to see what this me does," said Tiafoe, who plays either Shelton or defending champion Carlos Alcaraz next. "I have higher hopes for myself. So yeah, it's great. The tournament is still going. There's a lot more tennis to be played, a lot more sets to be played, and a lot more physical things to be done. We're going to enjoy this, but we got to keep going." Tiafoe advances with the ever-present American men's major drought looming over him, with U.S. fans having seen their hopes lifted — and then dashed — many times over the 23 years since Andy Roddick last lifted the trophy in New York. "I mean, the women's side, they've been killing it for so long. It's not something new," said Tiafoe, giving a wide smile as he rattled off a list of achievements from his female counterparts. "But the guys, we've been doing pretty well. Someone is always going deep in majors... I mean, hopefully we can do the thing, and that's ultimately try to do the thing after two weeks. That's like the next big step."

item.description: WASHINGTON: The National Transportation Safety Board said on Tuesday (Sep 8) that evidence recovered from a flight data recorder suggested the pilots considered aborting the landing of an Amazon Prime Air cargo plane before it crashed in Miami and

Evidence suggests pilots considered aborting landing in Miami cargo plane crash

WASHINGTON: The National Transportation Safety Board said on Tuesday (Sep 8) that evidence recovered from a flight data recorder suggested the pilots considered aborting the landing of an Amazon Prime Air cargo plane before it crashed in Miami and killed five people on the ground . The 32-year-old Boeing 767 operated by Miami-based 21 Air overran the runway by some 396m and crashed into two vehicles on the ground on Sunday, killing five people and injuring five others. NTSB Chair Jennifer Homendy said investigators would interview both of the pilots on Wednesday.

Miami Dade Fire Rescue officials inspect a damaged vehicle two days after an Amazon cargo plane overshot a runway at Miami International Airport on Sep 8, 2026, in Miami. (Photo: AP/Rebecca Blackwell)

Law enforcement officers walk in front of a destroyed engine as they inspect an Amazon cargo plane two days after it overshot a runway at Miami International Airport on Sep 8, 2026, in Miami. (Photo: AP/Rebecca Blackwell)

The NTSB said that 30 seconds before the end of the flight data recording, the nose landing gear and right main landing gear touched down, while 19 seconds before the end of the recording, the left main landing gear touched down. A few seconds later, the brakes were released, and the throttles were increased to values consistent with go-around thrust. The NTSB added that there was no indication in the recorded data that speed brakes or thrust reversers were deployed.

Source: Reuters/nh

item.title: Astros withstand rally for narrow road victory vs. Phillies
item.description: Christian Walker hit an early three-run homer and the visiting Houston Astros held on for a 6-5 victory over the Philadelphia Phillies on Tuesday.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: Christian Walker hit an early three-run homer and the visiting Houston Astros held on for a 6-5 victory over the Philadelphia Phillies on Tuesday. Philadelphia (81-64) rallied from a 5-0 deficit to get within 6-5 on Edmundo Sosa's ninth-inning RBI double against Josh Hader. However, the Houston closer recovered to get the next three hitters, including Kyle Schwarber on a game-ending popout. Hayden Wesneski (5-1) allowed three runs and five hits over six innings for Houston (74-71), while counterpart Andrew Painter (3-9) was charged with five runs and 10 hits in five frames. Daulton Varsho homered for the Astros as part of a 3-for-5 night, while Cam Smith also went deep for the visitors. Walker finished with two hits, as did Yainer Diaz. Trea Turner registered two hits, including a homer, for the Phillies. After an uneventful first inning, Houston plated four runs in the second frame against Painter. Varsho doubled to open the inning and advanced on a single by Diaz. The next hitter was Walker, who launched a shot over the fence in left-center field to make it 3-0. The Astros tacked on another run when Jeremy Pena delivered an RBI double later in the frame. Smith's leadoff home run in the fourth made it 5-0. Wesneski faced the minimum through three innings, allowing one hit that was promptly erased on a double play. He had no issues in the fourth or fifth innings, but the Phillies finally got to him in the sixth. Justin Crawford's one-out double set the stage for Schwarber's RBI single. Two pitches later, Turner sent one over the left-field wall to get the hosts within 5-3. Varsho answered with a home run of his own in the seventh - a solo shot against Brooks Raley - to increase the lead to 6-3. Philadelphia got a run back on Brandon Marsh's seventh-inning RBI double. However, with two runners in scoring position, the Phillies failed to plate another run, as J.T. Realmuto lined into a double play against AJ Blubaugh and Derek Hill struck out against Bennett Sousa. Houston's Bryan Abreu worked around a pair of baserunners in the eighth before Hader escaped the ninth to earn his 24th save. --Field Level Media

item.title: トランプ氏の「ニューアメリカ州」案、ニューメキシコ州住民は全面拒否
item.description:
Andrew Hay
[タオス（米ニューメキシコ州） ８日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Andrew Hay

[タオス（米ニューメキシコ州） ８日 ロイター] - トランプ米大統領が西部ニューメキシコ州を「ニューアメリカ州」に改称すると示唆したことについて、同州の住民らは８日、歴史と文化を消し去ろうとする試みだと一蹴し、全面拒否の姿勢を明確にした。

トランプ氏はメキシコとの貿易交渉が激化する中で、６日に改称案を示した。

ロイターが取材した十数人のニューメキシコ州住民は全員、この案に冷淡な反応を示し、同州の共和、民主両党の政治家らも案を退けた。

同州ピクリス・プエブロに暮らす陶芸家で、先住民コミュニティーに属するエセル・ヤザさん（６７）は「トランプ、あなたは正気じゃない。私たちから何一つ奪うことはできない」と語る。

同州の歴史家ロブ・マルティネス氏によると、１５６０年代にスペインの探検家らが「ラ・ヌエバ・メヒコ（ニューメキシコ）」と名付けた同州に最初に居住したのはプエブロの人々だ。マルティネス氏は「ニューメキシコは美しい名称であり、歴史的で、響きも素晴らしい。ニューアメリカにはそうした魅力がない」と切り捨てた。

メキシコ系米国人でペンキ・屋根職人のヘスス・トレビゾ・マルティネスさんは、ニューアメリカ案はメキシコにルーツを持つ人々に対する攻撃だと指摘。「純粋な人種差別からやっていることだ」と語った。

トランプ氏はなぜニューヨーク州やニュージャージー州の改名を試みないのか、と問う人々もいた。

２０２４年の大統領選でトランプ氏に投票した同州出身の米空軍法務管理者、ラリー・クルーズ氏（６５）は「ここまでして私たちの歴史を消し去ろうとすることが恐ろしい」と述べた。

item.title: Shipping traffic via Strait of Hormuz stays below 10-day average, data shows
item.description: Six commodity vessels transited the Strait of Hormuz on Tuesday, down from nine a day earlier and below the 10-day average of about 12, preliminary shipping data showed on Wednesday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Six commodity vessels transited the Strait of Hormuz on Tuesday, down from nine a day earlier and below the 10-day average of about 12, preliminary shipping data showed on Wednesday. The figures could change as some ships typically switch off their transponders during the voyage. Of the six vessels, five were entering and one was exiting, initial data from shiptracker Kpler showed at 0200 GMT. They included one Panamax and one intermediate tanker. The U.S.-Israeli war on Iran [USN:L6N45005Y TEXT:"intensified"] on Tuesday with Tehran-backed Houthis in Yemen launching strikes on several Saudi Arabian cities, further embroiling a U.S. ally in the conflict. In addition, American forces hit multiple Iranian oil tankers and Iran struck a U.S. base in Jordan. Meanwhile, 25 commodity vessels transited the Bab el-Mandeb strait on Tuesday, another major maritime chokepoint in the Middle East, with 11 vessels entering and 14 exiting. This compares with an average of around 27 ships going through Bab el-Mandeb over the past 10 days. Among the vessels travelling through the strait were two Suezmax tankers, eight Aframax tankers and one Very Large Crude Carrier.

item.title: Conflict over Taiwan would be disastrous, de facto US ambassador says
item.description: Any conflict across the Taiwan Strait would have a bigger impact on the global economy than World War Two, and the upcoming U.S.-China summit is an opportunity to avoid miscalculations, the top U.S. diplomat in Taipei said on Wednesday.
item.dc:creator: Ben Blanchard
item.content:encoded: Any conflict across the Taiwan Strait would have a bigger impact on the global economy than World War Two, and the upcoming U.S.-China summit is an opportunity to avoid miscalculations, the top U.S. diplomat in Taipei said on Wednesday. While the U.S., like most countries, has no formal diplomatic relations with Chinese-claimed Taiwan, it is the democratically governed island's most important international backer and arms supplier. Speaking at a defence forum in Taipei, Raymond Greene, director of the American Institute in Taiwan, said there was no topic more timely or important than how to secure peace in the Taiwan Strait. "Beyond the human toll, any conflict across the Taiwan Strait would have a bigger impact on the global economy than the Second World War," he said. "The United States under the Trump administration has made preserving peace in the Indo-Pacific one of its top priorities," Greene added. That includes "vigorous" diplomacy, especially at the highest levels, he said. "The upcoming U.S.-China summit is an opportunity to further advance a relationship of strategic stability, on the basis of fairness and reciprocity, that can avoid misunderstandings and miscalculations," Greene added. Chinese President Xi Jinping is expected to travel to the United States later this month for a meeting with President Donald Trump. Greene said that the U.S. was also reinforcing its presence and partnerships in the Indo-Pacific region to maintain a "favourable regional balance of power". "Third, and especially relevant to today's discussion, we are supporting Taiwan's work to enhance its ability to defend itself." Taiwan President Lai Ching-te's administration has made stepped-up defence spending and military modernisation priorities, given the threat level from China. The government, which rejects Beijing's sovereignty claims, has budgeted [USN:L1N44H03P TEXT:"defence spending"] for next year to exceed T$1 trillion for the first time. 'PRESERVE PEACE, FREEDOM' Speaking at the same event as Greene, Vice President Hsiao Bi-khim said Taiwan has a clear responsibility to strengthen its own defences and make its society better prepared to withstand a wide range of security challenges. "Our purpose, of course, is to preserve peace and the freedom of Taiwan's people to determine their future. Better preparation gives us a basis for pursuing that purpose with steadiness and strength," she added. China has never renounced the use of force to bring Taiwan under its control, though it says it would prefer a peaceful outcome under a "one country, two systems" model of autonomy no major Taiwanese political party supports. "The reunification of the motherland is an unstoppable historical trend," Chen Binhua, a spokesperson for China's Taiwan Affairs Office, told a regular news briefing in Beijing on Wednesday.

item.title: 新たな借り入れなしにはドイツを守れない＝財務相
item.description:
Maria Martinez
[ベルリン ８日 ロイター] - ドイツのクリングバイル財務相は８日、連邦議会下院で２０...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
新たな借り入れなしにはドイツを守れない＝財務相 11:07 配信

写真はクリングバイル独財務相。8日、ドイツのベルリンで撮影。 REUTERS/Liesa Johannssen

Maria Martinez

[ベルリン ８日 ロイター] - ドイツのクリングバイル財務相は８日、連邦議会下院で２０２７年度予算案について、脅威が高まる中での防衛費の増額を正当化し、「ドイツは新たな債務を負わなければ自国を守ることができない」と述べた。

トランプ米大統領が北大西洋条約機構（ＮＡＴＯ）加盟国に対してより多くの負担を求める圧力を強めていることや、当局がロシアやイランなどの国々からのサイバー脅威やハイブリッド脅威の増大を警告していることを受け、ドイツは防衛・安全保障への支出を拡大している。

ドイツ政府は７月に２７年予算案と３０年までの中期財政計画を閣議決定し、戦争に伴うエネルギーショックや長年にわたる投資不足から低迷するドイツ経済を守るため、投資と防衛費を増額した。

２７年から３０年にかけて、ドイツは総額８３８２億ユーロ（９７３２．３億ドル）の借り入れを計画している。

１９２０年代のハイパーインフレの経験が依然として国民心理に傷を残しているドイツでは、借り入れに対する反対意見が根強い。

だが、クリングバイル氏は「われわれは未来に投資し、安全保障に投資し、明日も行動し続けられる自由を築いている」と述べ、国を将来に向けてより強靭なものにするための投資拡大を擁護した。

５０００億ユーロのインフラ整備向け特別基金と、防衛分野における借入規制の緩和により、投資総額は前政権下での２５年の７８９億ユーロから、２７年には１１７５億ユーロに増加する見込みだ。

７月に承認された予算案によると、中核的な防衛費は２６年の８２２億ユーロから、２７年には１０９０億ユーロに増加する見込みだ。ウクライナへの支援やその他の安全保障関連支出を含めると、総額は１３０１億ユーロに達する。

クリングバイル氏は、ドイツが防衛に投資するのは戦争を行うためではなく、戦争しなくて済むようにするためだと述べ、ロシアの戦争はウクライナだけに留まらないと語った。

同氏はまた、防衛への投資が、低迷していたドイツ経済を成長軌道に戻す一助となっていると主張した。

イラン情勢による物価高や米国の関税措置による不確実性にもかかわらず、ドイツ経済は回復力を示し、第２・四半期には０．３％の成長を記録した。

複数の経済研究所は、政府支出の増加が今年上半期の予想を上回る回復を牽引したとして、２６年および２７年の経済成長予測を上方修正した。

item.title: ＧＥエアロスペース、鋳造部品メーカーを120億ドルで買収へ
item.description:
Rajesh Kumar Singh Shivansh Tiwary
[８日 ロイター] - 米航空機エンジン大手ＧＥ...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
ＧＥエアロスペース、鋳造部品メーカーを120億ドルで買収へ 11:03 配信

写真はＧＥエアロスペースのロゴ。7月23日、英ファーンバラで撮影。 REUTERS/Toby Melville

Rajesh Kumar Singh　Shivansh Tiwary

[８日 ロイター] - 米航空機エンジン大手ＧＥエアロスペースは８日、鋳造部品メーカーのコンソリデーテッド・プレシジョン・プロダクツ（ＣＰＰ）を１１７億５０００万ドルで買収すると発表した。生産能力の拡大を急ぐ中、エンジン関連サプライチェーン（供給網）の重要な部分を社内に取り込む。

今回の買収はサプライチェーンの制約に直接対処することが目的。ＧＥエアロスペースは今後１０年にわたる膨大な受注残を抱えており、既に受注済みの需要を満たすために十分な生産能力の確保を目指している。

ラリー・カルプ最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）は「民間用エンジン、アフターマーケット、防衛の各分野で同時に高まる需要を支えるために不可欠な鋳造能力への投資が必要だ」と述べた。

ＣＰＰは溶融材料を型に流し込んで製造する複雑な金属部品である精密砂型鋳造の世界大手の一角を占める。ＧＥの航空機エンジン「リープ」および「ＧＥｎｘ」の主要サプライヤーで、現行世代の主要商用機のほぼ全てに部品を供給して、売上高の約７０％を商用および防衛用エンジンが占める。

ＧＥはＣＰＰが２０２７年に約２０億ドルの売上高を生み出すと見込むとともに、エアフォイル（翼型部品）の需要が３０年までに２６年比３０％超増加すると予想する。エアフォイルにはエンジンの最も高温となる部分で動作するタービンブレードやベーンが含まれる。

ＧＥは、工場の歩留まりと機械稼働率を向上させると同時に、スクラップや手直しを削減することでＣＰＰの生産量を増加させることを想定。またエアフォイルの設計と製造を密接に連携させることで、開発期間の短縮と新部品の生産拡大の円滑化を期待している。

この買収においてＣＰＰの評価額は２７年予想コア利益の約２６倍となるが、ＧＥが期待する統合シナジー効果を加味すると、約１８倍の水準まで下がる。

ＧＥは買収資金のうち７０億ドルを現金で、残りを新規借入で賄う。買収手続きは２７年下半期に完了する見通しだ。

item.title: Reid Detmers, Zach Neto shine as Angels stop Red Sox streak
item.description: Reid Detmers pitched six scoreless innings and Zach Neto hit a two-run homer to help the visiting Los Angeles Angels beat the Boston Red Sox 6-1 Tuesday night.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: Reid Detmers pitched six scoreless innings and Zach Neto hit a two-run homer to help the visiting Los Angeles Angels beat the Boston Red Sox 6-1 Tuesday night. Detmers (5-8) limited Boston (80-66) to one hit, a first-inning single by Wilyer Abreu. He struck out nine and walked one. Detmers was pulled after throwing 112 pitches (73 strikes). Neto went 4 for 5 in the win. Los Angeles (55-90) received two-hit games from Vaughn Grissom, Christian Moore, Moises Ballesteros and Travis d'Arnaud. The Angels, who collected 15 hits in the win, entered Tuesday's game with two victories in their last 14 games. Boston starter Patrick Sandoval (1-5) allowed four runs on 10 hits in six innings. He struck out seven and walked two. The Red Sox were held to four hits and struck out 13 times. Nick Sogard collected two of the four hits and had Boston's lone RBI. It was the first time the Angels have beaten the Red Sox in five games this season. The loss ended Boston's five-game winning streak. The Angels opened the scoring in the second. Grissom doubled, moved to third on Ballesteros' bunt single and scored when Moore grounded into a double play. Los Angeles extended its lead to 3-0 in the third on RBI singles from Jose Siri and Grissom. It became 4-0 when d'Arnaud scored on Trout's double play in the fifth. Boston trimmed its deficit to 4-1 in the seventh. Trevor Story led off the inning with a double and scored on Sogard's single. Neto's fourth hit was a two-run homer in the ninth. It was his 24th of the season and gave Los Angeles a 6-1 lead. --Field Level Media

item.title: Travis Bazzana's blast gets Guardians past Orioles
item.description: Travis Bazzana hit a three-run home run and the Cleveland Guardians scored in four different innings to beat the host Baltimore Orioles 9-5 on Tuesday night.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: Travis Bazzana hit a three-run home run and the Cleveland Guardians scored in four different innings to beat the host Baltimore Orioles 9-5 on Tuesday night. Brayan Rocchio had two hits and knocked in two runs for the Guardians (74-72), who evened the three-game series by winning for the fourth time in their last six games. Angel Martinez, Petey Halpin and Patrick Bailey also provided two hits. Tim Herrin (3-4) pitched 1 1/3 shutout innings in relief of Tanner Bibee. Pete Alonso hit a two-run home run, but the Orioles (70-76) couldn't dig out of a 6-0 hole. They've lost seven of their last eight games. Baltimore starter Brandon Young (9-4) surrendered six runs on eight hits and two walks in 3 2/3 innings. He has gone five consecutive outings without a victory, though this marked his first loss during that span. Bibee was done after 4 1/3 innings, giving up five runs on six hits. Four relievers worked behind him without giving up a run. Martinez and Steven Kwan both scored two Cleveland runs as every batter in the Guardians' starting lineup either scored or drove in a run. Alonso joined Jackson Holliday with two hits for the Orioles. The Guardians scored on Jo Adell's first-inning single and Bailey's second-inning single. Bazzana's 11th homer came with two outs in the second. Halpin extended the lead to 6-0 with an RBI single in the third. The Orioles bounced back with a run in the fourth inning with Samuel Basallo's RBI groundout. Baltimore posted four more in the fifth, with Leody Taveras' double and Holliday's single both driving in a run before Alonso's 34th home run of the season. Cleveland tallied three unearned runs in the seventh off Alex Hoppe, capped by Rocchio's two-out, two-run single. --Field Level Media

28th amendment for Pakistan? Sindh’s boundaries stand in way of Munir’s gamble to expand power

‘There’s going to be a civil war in Sindh if 28th Amendment comes to a pass,’ says Ayesha Siddiqa. Husain Haqqani adds that taking Karachi out of Sindh would be akin to ‘creating a Maharashtra without Mumbai in it’.

Bantirani Patro

09 September, 2026 07:30 am IST

Facebook

Twitter

WhatsApp

Linkedin

Illustration: Soham Sen/ThePrint

Follow Us :

Text Size: A- A+

-->

New Delhi: The debate over redrawing of provincial boundaries in Pakistan through the highly anticipated 28th Amendment has reached a crescendo, particularly over speculation that it might involve division of the Sindh province. Talk of a divided Sindh has triggered backlash, most of all from the Pakistan People’s Party (PPP), which is a key constituent of the ruling federal coalition led by Pakistan Muslim League-Nawaz (PML-N).

Sindh, Pakistan’s second most populous province, has long been PPP’s political bastion. It has had a chief minister there since 2008, barring two brief and one relatively longer interregnum. The PPP’s objection is also born out of the fear that the 28th Amendment may separate Sindh’s capital, the port city of Karachi, from the rest of the province.

“It’s like attempting to create a Maharashtra without Mumbai in it,” said Husain Haqqani, senior fellow at Hudson Institute and Pakistan’s former ambassador to the US (2008-2011).

Show Full Article

“There is going to be a civil war in Sindh if the 28th Amendment comes to a pass,” Ayesha Siddiqa, senior fellow at the Department of War Studies at King’s College London, told ThePrint.

On 3 September, the Sindh Assembly unanimously passed a resolution rejecting any proposal or suggestions which may, in effect, alter the province’s existing territorial limits. Labeling Sindh as a “historic, civilizational and constitutional” entity, the resolution, according to The Express Tribune , highlighted that Sindh was “British India’s first provincial legislature to come out in support of Pakistan’s establishment on 3rd March 1943”.

“Sindh is one and shall remain one,” read the concluding line.

File photo of the Sindh Legislative Assembly | X @pasgovofficial The resolution also invoked Article 239(4) of the constitution Pakistan adopted in 1973, which says that any constitutional amendment which would have the effect of altering the limits of a province cannot be presented to the President for assent unless passed by the relevant provincial Assembly with a two-thirds majority.

Also Read: North Pakistan communities are marrying glaciers to make new ones

28th Amendment & ‘collapse’ of governance For weeks now, reports in the Pakistani media have hinted at the powers that be weighing a 28th Amendment, which may involve either creation of new provinces, administrative units, or empowerment of local governments. In late July, Pakistan’s interior minister Mohsin Naqvi remarked at the Pakistan Economic Summit that the current system of governance has “collapsed” and the country is in need of new administrative units.

A day later, DG-ISPR, spokesperson of Pakistan military’s media wing, endorsed Naqvi’s comments, saying, “…if good governance requires an administrative reset, then let that happen.”

These back-to-back statements were widely interpreted as a signal that the Pakistan’s military establishment is looking to restructure provinces, more so given Naqvi’s proximity to Chief of Defence Forces (CDF) Field Marshal Asim Munir.

File photo of Field Marshal Asim Munir during visit to Tilla Field Firing Ranges (TFFR) in Mangla, Pakistan on 1 May, 2025 | ISPR | Pool via Reuters The 28th amendment in the context of Munir’s powers is significant considering what the last amendment gave him in terms of power consolidation.  In November 2025, Pakistan’s national assembly passed the 27th Constitutional Amendment Bill, which made Asim Munir Field Marshal for life, the chief of all defence forces, including the navy and the air force, and gave him President-like immunity from prosecution. Meanwhile, the 26th Amendment had increased the Army chief’s term to five years, extendable for another five.

On 5 September, Naqvi doubled down, asserting that he will not “back down” from his position whether he remains in his job or not, and that new administrative units should be created according to the will of the people, and not on the basis of ethnicity or community.

File photo of Mohsin Naqvi | X/@MohsinnaqviC42 Some political commentators in Pakistan saw the latest remarks as Naqvi hinting at the possibility of a referendum.

Ayesha Siddiqa sees it differently. “I don’t think they will go for a referendum. The earlier referendums in Pakistan were mostly about extending tenures of military chiefs as Presidents, like in the case of Zia-ul-Haq and Pervez Musharraf. These referendums were rigged.”

This time, a referendum cannot be initiated unless martial law is first imposed.

— Ayesha Siddiqa

While it is not new, the debate over redrawing provincial boundaries gained fresh momentum after the passage of the contentious 26th (2024) and 27th (2025) amendments, which emboldened the Pakistani Establishment to push through more consequential changes to the constitution. The 28th Amendment, if introduced, would be the most sweeping overhaul of the provincial system since the 18th Amendment.

Passed in 2010, the 18th Amendment not only devolved significant autonomy and powers to provincial governments, but also cemented the 7th National Financial Commission (NFC) Award of 2009, which increased provinces’ share of the federal divisible pool of taxes to 57.5 percent, with the federal government retaining the remaining 42.5 percent.

Now, the federal government wants a greater share of funds for debt restructuring and defence needs, and may be looking to amend the NFC award to this end.

Provinces view this with deep suspicion, seeing it as an attempt to chip away at their autonomy and centralise federal authority further.

According to Husain Haqqani, the 28th Amendment is “not so much about creating new provinces,” but undoing existing provinces to divert more resources to the federal government.

“Usually, when the establishment is defence-oriented, they try to find new funds for that purpose.”

— Husain Haqqani

“The establishment believes the provinces squander money and think there is more corruption in the provinces,” Haqqani told ThePrint, adding that the boundaries of the provinces are more or less what they were in 1947.

Since provinces have failed to devolve powers to local bodies, as mandated under Article 140A, resulting in weak governance at the grassroots level, the Pakistani Establishment is using this rationale to push for provincial reorganisation.

Circling back to the 18th Amendment, Haqqani explained that the idea was to empower provinces to provide better schooling and overall good governance at the grassroots.

“In the process, the central government believes they have taken disproportionate resources and now wants greater control over them. The establishment does not particularly care about schools and healthcare. Pakistan has some of the worst human development indicators,” he said.

Haqqani also described the Pakistani Establishment’s approach as one aimed at creating a “new country with very little regard of the pre-Pakistan history”.

“The establishment thinks if the boundaries are erased, then their idea of Pakistan will be further advanced,” he said, adding that this has been the Pakistani Establishment’s “modus operandi for some time”.

Imran Khan factor The PPP’s staunch opposition to the idea of a divided Sindh puts the ruling coalition led by PML-N in a fix, given that for any constitutional amendment to be passed, the government will require a two-thirds majority in both houses of parliament.

The 28th Amendment, said Siddiqa, may be tabled officially at the end of this month.

If the PPP backs out, the only way a constitutional amendment will clear either the National Assembly or the Senate is if the PML-N and jailed former Prime Minister Imran Khan’s Pakistan Tehreek-e-Insaaf (PTI) come together.

File photo of former Pakistani Prime Minister Imran Khan | Reuters “Anything can happen. But the question is if Imran Khan will agree,” Siddiqa told ThePrint.

Asked whether the Pakistani Establishment is softening towards Imran to show the PPP that it can align with the PTI if the need arises, she said, “The establishment is signalling so. The next Supreme Court hearing on Imran Khan’s hospital transfer would be important to watch in this regard.”

Also Read: Italian embassy in Pakistan warns students over ‘unprecedented surge’ in forged visa documents

Zardari’s PPP at war? The PPP is not the only Sindh-centric political force weighing in on the potential redrawing of provincial boundaries. Altaf Hussain, founder of the Muttahida Qaumi Movement (MQM), has sounded alarm bells too.

Pakistan, he said earlier this month, is “rapidly heading toward its most dangerous phase”.

Altaf, once described by the BBC as a “powerful but absent politician,” lives in self-imposed exile in London and founded MQM as the flagbearer of the rights of Mohajirs—the Urdu-speaking community that migrated from India to Pakistan after the Partition.

Addressing supporters on 2 September, during his 462nd Emergency Intellectual Session on TikTok, Altaf claimed deliberations on the 28th Amendment are underway, which could include the creation of new provinces, and that this debate “should never be taken lightly”.

He subsequently uploaded his message in a long post on X the next day, while also accusing the PPP of attempting to inflame tensions in Sindh.

کراچی کی یہ صورتحال دیکھ کر مجھے بہت دکھ ہوتا ہے۔ الطاف حسین #Karachi کراچی پاکستان کا پہلا دارالخلافہ تھا لیکن دارالخلافہ اسلام آباد منتقل کردیا گیا، کراچی قومی خزانے میں سب سے زیادہ ریونیو دیتا ہے لیکن کراچی کو اس کا جائز حق نہیں ملتا، سندھ میں 18 سال سے پیپلزپارٹی کی حکومت… pic.twitter.com/4eqgxYuyiK

— Altaf Hussain (@AltafHussain_90) August 29, 2026

Haqqani pointed out that the tussle between PPP and MQM is not new. “From the MQM’s point of view, it makes tremendous sense to have Karachi as a self-governing unit. MQM is aligned with the establishment on this.” The MQM-Pakistan (MQM-P) had boycotted the session in which the Sindh Assembly passed the Resolution.

Siddiqa sees it from the lens of Karachi’s changing population dynamics.

MQM is supporting the creation of Karachi into a new province, but it has more Pashtuns than Urdu-speaking Mohajirs. And Altaf Hussain has no receptivity in Pakistan.

— Ayesha Siddiqa

In his address, Altaf also claimed a “silent war” has begun between Pakistan’s military establishment and the President, Asif Ali Zardari, who co-shares PPP’s leadership along with son Bilawal Bhutto Zardari. Altaf alleged that political parties including the PPP had engaged in “joint horse-trading” to pass the 26th and 27th amendments.

If President Zardari won’t accept it, the Pakistani Establishment could still push through the 28th Amendment by imposing martial law and setting up a caretaker government, which can pass any amendments and then get those validated by the Supreme Court, said Altaf.

File photo of Asif Ali Zardari | Reuters On the possibility of martial law being imposed, Haqqani told ThePrint, “Pakistan has had multiple experiments in its governance and has had various forms of hybrid governance. One should not rule out anything in Pakistan, as the rules of the game are not firmly established in the country.”

‘In Pakistan, there is no debate’ Although PPP leaders fear Sindh’s division, in particular Karachi being a separate unit, they have in the past paid lip service towards the creation of a South Punjab province.

Siddiqa points to resolutions passed in 2012, when the PPP was heading the federal government, in support of carving out separate South Punjab and Bahawalpur provinces from the existing Punjab province. “These resolutions were not implemented. Two new provinces did not come out. A South Punjab Secretariat was formed, but it all kind of unravelled. Still, Sindh did not push too hard for a South Punjab province, because the Punjabis would say, ‘let’s divide Sindh as well—divide interior Sindh from urban Sindh’.”

She explained that Bahawalpur, a separate province in 1947, was merged with Punjab under the One Unit scheme in the early 1950s.

“It is not that Pakistan does not need new provinces today. Residents of Dera Ghazi Khan, Bahawalpur and Multan have to come all the way to Lahore because the Secretariat is there. The problem is that there isn’t much of a debate. India debated for years, formed a committee when it was reorganising states. In Pakistan, there is no debate. It is very top-down. The only thing which is happening is people saying that new provinces are a popular formula, but they are problematic since it will require new bureaucracies, new Chief Ministers and so on,” said Siddiqa.

Haqqani echoed a similar view.

“The Sindhis and Baloch are very particular about guarding their identity. They are not just ethnic groups, but nationalities in themselves that came together to form Pakistan and their identity precedes their new Pakistani identity. So, they feel if there is any division of their traditional homelands, then it would completely dilute their identities.

Sindh was an independent kingdom until 1843 when the Britishers annexed it. Sindhis have a distinct culture, language and history. They were also among the first ones to support the creation of Pakistan.

— Husain Haqqani

Haqqani underlined that resistance to the idea of a divided Sindh also stems from the economic advantage derived from Karachi. “Karachi is the single largest contributor of tax revenue to Pakistan’s federal government as well as the provincial Sindh government,” he said. H e pointed out that Karachi was Pakistan’s first capital, too, and that there have been “many attempts to take Karachi out of Sindh’s hands”.

“It will be a rough ride getting it passed,” Haqqani said of the 28th Amendment, adding, “Pakistan usually ends up with a lot of political noise and noise is seen as turmoil, but right now the establishment has firm control. I don’t think turmoil is the real fear. The real fear is the absence of national consensus for constitutional amendment.”

(Edited by Amrtansh Arora)
